com.invoiceparserpro/capability.description: Correct selected fields on one saved invoice. Financial corrections can reset approval; invalid or unsupported values are refused. Review and confirm the exact change first. The preview expires after five minutes.
examples: For our fictional practice invoice, preview correcting only the invoice number to DEMO-104. Show the current value and wait for my confirmation.
Preview clearing the selected invoice's due date. Show the change and whether it affects approval, then wait for my confirmation.

description: Apply only the exact change returned by preview_edit_invoice_fields, after the user confirms that preview. Accepts its confirmation_token only; changed or expired records require a new preview. Prepare a bounded change to saved invoice header fields. Requires confirmation; financial edits may reset approval. Unknown fields and invalid currencies are refused.

confirmation_token.description: The exact token returned by this operation’s preview, after the user confirms its displayed changes.
confirmation_token.title: Confirmation Token
